description: Source code implementing directory iteration functions for a Git-related project, including structures and functions for traversing directories, handling directory entries, and managing iteration state.

methods.name: next_directory_entry
methods.description: Reads the next directory entry, skipping '.' and '..', and handles errors.

methods.name: push_level
methods.description: Pushes a new directory level onto the iteration stack, opening the directory and optionally reading/sorting entries.

methods.name: pop_level
methods.description: Removes the top directory level from the stack, closing the directory and clearing entries.

methods.name: prepare_next_entry_data
methods.description: Prepares the next directory entry data, updating path and stat info.

methods.name: dir_iterator_begin
methods.description: Initializes and begins directory iteration at a specified path with given flags.

methods.name: dir_iterator_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a directory iterator.

methods.name: dir_iterator_advance
methods.description: Advances the directory iterator to the next entry.
